newsitem.title: UK: Mobil and Elf swap North sea oilfield interests.
newsitem.headline: Mobil and Elf swap North sea oilfield interests.

text.p: Mobil and Elf have swapped interest in two North Sea oil fields, a statement from Mobil said on Friday.

"The swap is an important step in our strategy to increase our equity interest in core areas of our business, a strategy which was the focal point for Mobil in the 16th licence round," said Mobil North Sea Ltd's chairman John Cousins.
The swap deal gives Mobil North Sea Ltd (MNSL) 15 percent of Blocks 9/10b, 9/14a and part of 9/15a in an area close to its Beryl field.
In the remaining part of Block 9/15a Mobil has acquireed a 66.67 percent interest in the UK sector of discovery known as the Peik field which straddles the U.K/Norway sector boundary.
In return Elf receives from Mobil 16.5 percent in part of block 22/30b containing part of the Elgin field.
Mobil will have the opportunity to increase its 15 percent share in the three blocks once farm-in work has been completed.
